capabilities: Render any folder as a zoomable, pannable coral structure of branches and liefs
Create, rename, promote and delete folders and notes from the coral view
Seed a folder with a Growth Charter and agent pointer files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md)
Log agent prompts and responses as notes and roll up summaries into meristem notes
Open a terminal per branch (via the community Terminal plugin) as an agent dashboard
extras: Freemium: free for individual use, commercial licence required for organizations; optional 'Liefwork Pro' one-time purchase via Lemon Squeezy unlocks only cosmetic perks. Desktop only (requires Node's fs for folder creation times); requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. The coral pane is dark-only in both themes. README notes a pre-0.1.6 seeding bug requiring re-seed. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer gives no spatial overview of folder structure, and AI agents starting a session must re-read long histories to get current.

relations.evidence: Claude Code can carry a reminder alongside them. Leave Install the Claude Code logging hook on when you seed

summary: Renders folders as a zoomable 2D 'coral' tree and seeds folders with a memory system of roll-up notes for AI coding agents.
